claim: A calibrated complex two-resonator transfer measurement separates the genuine orientation-odd seam amplitude from a false odd-power effect caused by coherent direct feedthrough.
predictions: background-subtracted complex transfer is odd under epsilon reversal
corrected seam power is even under epsilon reversal
raw power generally contains a false linear odd term from feedthrough
homodyne amplitude scales linearly and corrected power quadratically at small coupling
decision: Fit and validate one complex transfer model across orientations, phases and held-out points before treating any residual as anomalous.
